cyberpanelSsh.name: CyberPanel / HestiaCP / aaPanel / Plesk via SSH
cyberpanelSsh.description: Connect over SSH and discover websites with their databases. Panel type is auto-detected.

cpanelFull.name: cPanel Full Backup
cpanelFull.description: Restore a complete cpmove account or selected resources.

dpanelFull.name: DPanel to DPanel
dpanelFull.description: Migrate a complete DPanel backup package to this server.

cpanelPartial.name: cPanel Partial Backup
cpanelPartial.description: Import Home Directory and MySQL backups downloaded separately from cPanel.

directadmin.name: DirectAdmin Backup
directadmin.description: Migrate a DirectAdmin user with all or selected domains and databases.

plesk.name: Plesk Backup Archive
plesk.description: Import from an uploaded .tar Plesk backup file. For a live Plesk server, use CyberPanel / HestiaCP / aaPanel / Plesk via SSH above instead.

wordpress.name: WordPress Migration
wordpress.description: Move a WordPress site (files + database) into a website here; its address is updated to the new domain.

cpanel.title: cPanel Full Backup
cpanel.description: Supports cpmove-USER.tar.gz and Backup Wizard backup-MM.DD.YYYY_HH-MM-SS_USER.tar.gz. After inspection, restore the whole account or select domains, files, and databases independently.

cpanelPartial.title: cPanel Partial Backup
cpanelPartial.description: Upload the Home Directory backup and any MySQL database backups from cPanel → Backup. Partial backups do not record the account, so enter the system user (and main domain) they should be restored to.

directadmin.title: DirectAdmin Backup
directadmin.description: Upload a user backup created in DirectAdmin (user.RESELLER.USER.tar.gz or .tar.zst). Domains are restored to /home/USER/domains/DOMAIN/public_html, as on DirectAdmin.

plesk.title: Plesk Backup Archive
plesk.description: Upload a backup downloaded from Plesk Backup Manager, made without password protection. Each domain is restored to /home/USER/domains/DOMAIN with the site in httpdocs.

index.uploadComplete: Upload complete. DPanel package validation is running.
index.restoreNotStarted: DPanel restore could not be started.
index.chooseServiceHelp: Select where the backup came from and what kind of package you have.

wp.intro: Create the website first, then import into it. You need the WordPress files (a .zip or .tar.gz of the folder holding {config}) and a database export (.sql, e.g. from phpMyAdmin or {cmd}).
wp.step1: The files replace the website's files; the current ones are kept in its trash first.
wp.step2: The database is imported, and {config} is pointed at it.
wp.step3: The site address ({a}, {b}) and links in posts move to the new domain.
wp.noWebsite: No website yet. {link} for the domain first.

dpanel.title: DPanel Full Migration
dpanel.description: Upload a full backup package created by DPanel. The package is validated before restoring.
dpanel.warning: restoring replaces the target server's {env}, {storage} data, and configured panel database with the source backup. This is not a website-only migration. Make a separate target backup first and continue only on the intended target server.

index.uploadedHelp: Continue a full or partial restore from any retained archive.
index.connected: {site} ({framework}) is connected to database {database} with a new login.
index.typeRestore: Type {word} to confirm replacing this DPanel server
index.fullAccountHelp: All domains, home files, and databases

ssh.loadFailed: Could not load the saved SSH connection.
ssh.deleteFailed: Could not delete the saved SSH connection.
ssh.inspectFailed: Could not inspect the CyberPanel server.
ssh.stepFailed: Migration step failed. Retry after fixing the reported problem.
ssh.downloadFailed: Selected source could not be downloaded.
ssh.connectHelp: CyberPanel, HestiaCP, aaPanel and Plesk are auto-detected. Credentials are used for the current request and stored only when you enable Save SSH access.
ssh.saveAccessHelp: Not recommended unless necessary. Password/private key will be encrypted in DPanel's database. Never enable this on an untrusted panel installation.
ssh.sourcePathHelp: Type any valid location or select a discovered directory.
ssh.parentHelp: Select an existing parent or type a new one. A missing parent will be created automatically.
ssh.onlyThis: Only this file location and this database will be handled. Other websites and databases will not be included.
